metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz replays the validated Sharpa Wave authoring trajectory on the Marvin right arm (942 controls; success after 742, then 200 unexecuted hold rows of slack). Two fresh-process replays succeed with identical state hashes. The standard oracle submits the same rows through the public client.

notes.layout: Each row starts with the 14 Marvin arm joint targets (left arm J1-J7, then right arm J1-J7), followed by the left hand's finger targets and then the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`); the left arm is parked and only the right arm/hand perform the task.
